title: Knowledge Interoperability
definition: The ability of different knowledge systems to understand and communicate with each other, enabling the seamless exchange and integration of information.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine knowledge as a global language. Knowledge interoperability is like making sure everyone speaks the same language so we can all understand and share information without confusion.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Knowledge interoperability involves standardizing data formats and protocols, allowing for the easy exchange and merging of information between different systems and platforms.
difficulty_levels.expert: Knowledge interoperability expands upon semantic web technologies, enabling meaning to be derived from data. It also considers the social and organizational context, addressing challenges like data silos, privacy concerns, and trust issues in large-scale knowledge systems.

extra_fields.insight: The CADMIES system's ability to understand and communicate with different knowledge systems, showcasing knowledge interoperability.
